# Yes, the packages will be deleted

When you run `pyenv virtualenv-delete <venv-name>`, the **entire virtual environment directory is removed**, which includes:

- ✅ All installed packages
- ✅ The Python interpreter for that venv
- ✅ All configuration files
- ✅ Everything else in that venv

## Example

```bash
# Create a venv and install a package
pyenv virtualenv 3.11.0 my-env
pyenv activate my-env
pip install requests

# Delete the venv - packages are gone
pyenv virtualenv-delete my-env
```

After deletion, `requests` and any other packages you installed are completely removed.

## If you want to keep packages

If you need to preserve your dependencies before deleting:

```bash
# Save your dependencies
pip freeze > requirements.txt

# Delete the venv
pyenv virtualenv-delete my-env

# Recreate and reinstall
pyenv virtualenv 3.11.0 my-env
pyenv activate my-env
pip install -r requirements.txt
```
